name: 单样本 t 检验计算器

map.总体标准差未知时，用样本标准差检验均值偏离。: When the population standard deviation is unknown, the sample standard deviation is used to test departures of the mean.
map.📖 查看「单样本 t 检验计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "One-Sample t-Test Calculator User Guide"
map.σ 未知时改用 t 检验。: Use a t-test when σ is unknown.
map.检验样本均值是否等于已知值：t=(x̄−m0)/(s/√n)。: Tests whether the sample mean equals a known value: t=(x̄−m0)/(s/√n).
map.df=n−1，小样本用 t 分布。: df=n−1; the t distribution applies to small samples.
map.判断偏离是否有统计意义。: Judges whether the deviation is statistically meaningful.
map.x̄=105、m0=100、s=15、n=25：t=5/(15/5)=5/3≈1: x̄=105, m0=100, s=15, n=25: t=5/(15/5)=5/3≈1.667, df=24. The critical value t(0.05,24)≈2.064 is not reached, so the result is not significant (p≈0.108).
map.x̄=112：t=12/3=4.0，远超临界，显著（p<0.001）。: With x̄=112: t=12/3=4.0, far beyond the critical value and significant (p<0.001).
map.为何用 t 而非 z？: Why use t rather than z?
map.σ 未知用样本 s 估计，小样本下 s 波动使 t 分布更胖尾，比 z 保守。: With σ unknown it is estimated by the sample s; in small samples the variability of s gives the t distribution heavier tails, making it more conservative than z.
map.由 t 与 df 查 t 分布，双尾 p=2×P(T>|t|)；本工具内置 er: Look up the t distribution using t and df; the two-tailed p=2×P(T>|t|). This tool computes it with built-in erf and betai functions.
